story.hr: U Muse se pleše bachata — glazba, osnovni koraci i ljudi koji su jednom također došli prvi put. Nitko ne mora doći u paru i nitko ne mora znati ništa unaprijed.
story.en: At Muse we dance bachata — the music, the basic steps, and people who once walked in for the first time too. Nobody has to bring a partner and nobody has to know anything in advance.

story.hr: Na satu ima vremena ponoviti isti korak dok ne sjedne, i pitati ponovno ako nije. Dođi, probaj, pa odluči.
story.en: In class there is time to repeat a step until it settles, and to ask again if it has not. Come, try it, and then decide.

lede.hr: Bachata je partnerski ples iz Dominikanske Republike. Broji se u četiri, naglasak je na četvrtoj dobi, i jedna osoba vodi dok druga prati. To je cijela osnova; sve ostalo su varijacije na nju.
lede.en: Bachata is a partner dance from the Dominican Republic. It is counted in four, the accent falls on the fourth beat, and one person leads while the other follows. That is the whole foundation; everything else is a variation on it.

body.hr: Bachata je nastala u Dominikanskoj Republici, iz bolera, s utjecajima sona i merenguea. Bila je to glazba sela i gradskih periferija, snimana s dvije gitare, basom, bongom i güirom, i desetljećima je u vlastitoj zemlji nosila stigmu glazbe koju se slušalo bez priznavanja.
body.en: Bachata grew out of bolero in the Dominican Republic, with son and merengue in it. It was the music of the countryside and the edges of the cities, recorded with two guitars, bass, bongo and güira, and for decades it carried a stigma at home — music people listened to without admitting it.

body.hr: Izvan otoka proširila se osamdesetih i devedesetih, kad su snimke prvi put dobile veliku publiku. UNESCO je dominikansku bachatu upisao na popis nematerijalne kulturne baštine čovječanstva.
body.en: It spread beyond the island in the 1980s and 1990s, when the recordings first reached a large audience. UNESCO has since added Dominican bachata to its list of the intangible cultural heritage of humanity.

body.hr: Osnovni korak ide u četiri dobe: tri koraka i naglasak na četvrtoj. Naglasak se najčešće vidi kao podignuto stopalo ili pokret kuka, ali može biti i samo kratka pauza.
body.en: The basic step runs over four beats: three steps and an accent on the fourth. The accent usually shows as a lifted foot or a movement of the hip, but it can be nothing more than a short pause.

body.hr: Ta četvrta doba je ono po čemu se bachata prepoznaje i ono što se uči prvo. Kad sjedne, glazba sama vodi korak i brojanje više nije posao.
body.en: That fourth beat is what makes bachata recognisable and it is the first thing anyone learns. Once it settles, the music leads the step and counting stops being work.

heading.hr: Vodi se i prati, ne pamti

body.hr: Bachata nije koreografija. Jedna osoba vodi, druga prati, a što će se plesati odlučuje se u trenutku — zato se isti ples može plesati s nekim koga prvi put vidiš i zato dva plesa nikad nisu ista.
body.en: Bachata is not choreography. One person leads, the other follows, and what gets danced is decided in the moment — which is why the same dance works with somebody you have just met, and why no two dances are alike.

body.hr: Vođenje je ponuda, ne naredba. Tko vodi ostavlja prostor, tko prati ga koristi, i obje su strane aktivne — što je obično prvo iznenađenje za nekoga kome se sa strane činilo da jedan radi sve.
body.en: A lead is an offer rather than an instruction. Whoever leads leaves room, whoever follows uses it, and both sides are active — which is usually the first surprise for anyone who assumed from the outside that one person does all the work.

heading.en: The styles exist, and they differ

body.hr: Danas se bachata pleše u više stilova: tradicionalna dominikanska ostaje najbliža glazbi s otoka i najviše se događa u stopalima, moderna je pojednostavnila osnovu i preuzela figure iz salse, a sensual je najmlađa i naglašava pokret tijela i vođenje kroz torzo.
body.en: Bachata is danced in several styles today: traditional Dominican stays closest to the music from the island and most of it happens in the feet, modern simplified the basic and borrowed figures from salsa, and sensual is the youngest of the three and emphasises body movement and leading through the torso.

body.hr: Stilovi se ne isključuju i većina plesača s vremenom pokupi nešto od svakoga. Ova stranica opisuje ples; što se uči u studiju i kada piše u rasporedu.
body.en: The styles are not exclusive, and most dancers end up with something from each. This page describes the dance; what is taught at the studio, and when, is on the schedule.

body.hr: Bachata je društveni ples. Pleše se na socialima i partyjima, najčešće s ljudima koje ne poznaješ, i to je obično, a ne nešto za što treba hrabrost. Pozvati nekoga na ples, otplesati pjesmu i reći hvala — to je cijeli protokol.
body.en: Bachata is a social dance. It is danced at socials and parties, usually with people you do not know, and that is ordinary rather than something requiring courage. Ask somebody to dance, dance the song, say thank you — that is the whole protocol.

body.hr: Ne treba ti vlastiti par. Na plesnom podiju se pleše s onima koji su tu, i to je dio načina na koji ovaj ples postoji.
body.en: You do not need a partner of your own. On a dance floor you dance with whoever is there, and that is part of how this dance exists at all.
